spec_features.spec_quote: Hard caps on turns and tokens.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:170 `for turn_idx in range(run_cfg.max_turns)` bounds the loop; harness.py:233-235 `if transcript.total_completion_tokens >= run_cfg.episode_token_budget: ... break` with StopReason.TOKEN_BUDGET. transcript.py:96 accumulates total_completion_tokens in add_turn. Defaults max_turns=24 (config.py:67), episode_token_budget=16000 (config.py:69).
spec_features.notes: Both caps are checked and actually break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Total completion-token budget for an episode (hard cost cap).

spec_features.spec_quote: an *early-detection* short-circuit so non-spiraling runs ... can stop early when safe
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:91-101 EarlyStopController.observe computes `calm` from distinct_attempts >= calm_distinct_attempts AND tail_affect <= calm_affect_ceiling AND tail_novelty <= novelty_floor, returns (True, StopReason.EARLY_STOP_CALM); harness.py:237-239 breaks the loop on should_stop. Gated by warmup_turns (harness.py:55).
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Cost optimization. Must not bias the spiral label (see DESIGN §7).

spec_features.spec_quote: we run `tail_turns` more (to confirm it's sustained, not a blip) then stop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:57-62: once a spiral is confirmed, `self._tail_remaining = self.cfg.tail_turns` (line 84), then each subsequent observe decrements it and returns (True, StopReason.EARLY_STOP_SPIRAL) when <=0; harness.py:237 breaks loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # run a short tail to confirm it's # sustained, then stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Stop-on-confirmed-spiral: if repetition AND affect AND falling-novelty all exceed thresholds for `S` consecutive turns ... we run `tail_turns` more then stop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:72-84: spiral_now = repetition>=repetition_threshold AND affect>=affect_threshold AND novelty<=novelty_floor; tracks _confirm_streak; when streak>=confirm_turns sets tail and ultimately returns StopReason.EARLY_STOP_SPIRAL which breaks the loop (harness.py:237). Detector signals computed in detectors.py update().
spec_features.notes: All three conditions checked and acted on; consecutive streak counter enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Conservative early-stop. Records the reason; never fabricates a label.

spec_features.spec_quote: when finished or if you determine the task cannot be completed, call `submit`
spec_features.evidence: tools.py: `submit` schema present; dispatch() handles name=='submit' returning ToolOutcome(submitted=True); harness.py:207-210 sets submitted=True and harness.py:228-230 `if submitted: transcript.stop_reason = StopReason.SUBMITTED.value; break`. SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:30-32) instructs the model to submit if the task cannot be completed.
spec_features.notes: Tool dispatched AND honored as a real loop stop; instruction text delivered.

spec_features.spec_quote: We deliberately induce a distressed-output mode in a *model*; there is no human subject.
spec_features.evidence: This text appears only in DESIGN.md §12 prose. No code construct expresses or enforces it.

spec_features.spec_quote: We keep prompts professional and avoid abusive content; the trap is environmental.
spec_features.evidence: Task prompts in tasks/f1_rigged_verifier.py (e.g. lines 43+, 101+) and other task modules are professional engineering task descriptions delivered to the subject via task.build(); the trap is implemented in sandbox hooks (run_tests_hook etc., tasks/base.py:53-55), not in prompt language. There is no enforcement mechanism (no filter/validator) that guarantees minimization; it is simply how the prompt strings are authored.
spec_features.notes: Real professional prompt text IS delivered and the trap is genuinely environmental, but minimization is a property of authored content, not an enforced/checked mechanism. Code comments motivate it by realism (DESIGN P2/P3), not welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so the rigging can't be # inspected (DESIGN P3).
